name: Easy Slow Cooker Beef Stroganoff with Mushrooms & Lasagna Noodles

ingredients.name: dry white wine (such as Sauvignon Blanc)

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the beef dry with paper towels and place in a medium bowl. Add flour, salt, and pepper, then stir to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb beef for stew
¼ cup all-purpose flour
1 tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add beef and cook, turning occasionally, until browned on all sides, 3-4 minutes (the beef will not be cooked all the way through). Transfer beef to a 6-quart slow cooker insert. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and small dice onion. Add to the slow cooker with the beef.

When the beef is done, return skillet (with drippings) to medium heat. Add wine and cook, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the skillet, until the liquid is reduced by half, 2-3 minutes. Carefully add to the slow cooker, along with broth, mushrooms, vinegar, Dijon, garlic, and Worcestershire. Stir to combine, then cover and cook until the meat is tender and flavors have blended, LOW for 5-6 hours or HIGH for about 3 hours.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup dry white wine (such as Sauvignon Blanc)
4 cups beef broth
2 (8 oz) pkg sliced white mushrooms
2 tbsp red wine vinegar
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
2 tsp minced garlic
1 tsp Worcestershire sauce

instructions.primary_message: When the beef is tender, break lasagna noodles into 2-inch pieces and add to the slow cooker. Stir to combine the stroganoff and continue to cook until noodles are tender, 1 hour more.

When the noodles are done, place sour cream in a clean medium bowl. Add 1/2-cup of broth from the slow cooker, then whisk to combine. Slowly add the sour cream mixture to the slow cooker, stirring to combine. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide beef stroganoff and noodles between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
